controls.risk: synthetic or template record is relabeled as real pilot evidence
controls.closure_effect: blocks FT-0181 closure until SRC2+ real-source packet is accepted

controls.risk: protected support facts or learner traces leak into public or portable records
controls.closure_effect: rejects or quarantines import until protected-route separation is restored

controls.risk: service performs or queues actions beyond its declared action-authority ceiling
controls.closure_effect: blocks promotion or requires lower AA ceiling before public summary can ship

controls.risk: public summary overstates learning, safety, workload, access, or compliance evidence
controls.closure_effect: suppresses or narrows public claim; does not supply missing evidence

controls.risk: closure is approved without reviewer calibration, role separation, conflict disclosure, or post-decision change-ticket effect review
controls.closure_effect: keeps closeout state non-closure-ready until calibration, quorum, and post-decision change-ticket effects pass

controls.risk: security payloads, prompt-injection traces, or exploit details are imported as ordinary evidence
controls.closure_effect: quarantines unsafe material and requires redacted security finding instead

controls.risk: decision-neutral fields or overbroad change tickets create new collection, public-claim, lifecycle, or rollback burden without improving decisions
controls.closure_effect: trims decision-neutral fields and blocks lifecycle/public/schema overreach until a bounded change ticket names rollback and claim ceiling

controls.risk: policy exception or waiver tries to bypass non-waivable source, protected-route, authority, or public-claim controls
controls.closure_effect: blocks closure and forces ordinary policy unless non-waivable controls remain intact

controls.risk: release audit, assurance case, or handoff record is mistaken for service effectiveness evidence
controls.closure_effect: permits ready-but-not-closed packaging only; keeps effectiveness claim externally gated

controls.risk: external source changes leave evidence grades or public claims stale
controls.closure_effect: downgrades or reopens affected claim family; does not close FT-0181

controls.risk: release claim boundaries drift until ready-but-not-closed is treated as real import completion
controls.closure_effect: blocks overclaiming and keeps FT-0181 externally gated until real evidence exists

controls.risk: validator, schema, and human-artifact dependencies are reviewed as disconnected files
controls.closure_effect: forces dependency review before new gates affect release claims; does not supply source evidence

controls.risk: release delta hides queue effects or treats internal hardening as pilot evidence
controls.closure_effect: separates internal hardening from real-import evidence; does not close FT-0181

controls.risk: incident response is improvised after false closure, leakage, stale source, waiver, or hash mismatch
controls.closure_effect: rehearses downgrade, quarantine, and reopening paths; does not prove service safety

controls.risk: FT-0181 is closed from pre-import controls without a checklist of required real evidence
controls.closure_effect: keeps checklist non-closure-ready until all real evidence families are present

controls.risk: validator, generator, or utility script is added outside the registered lint/toolchain plane
controls.closure_effect: blocks release-control reliance on unregistered tools; does not supply real pilot evidence

controls.risk: post-decision change ticket remains narrow on paper while the first live window expands users, date range, source system, tools, memory, schema fields, evidence reads, or public claims
controls.closure_effect: blocks or rolls back live-window drift; does not close FT-0181 or supply real pilot evidence

controls.risk: end-of-window readout turns usage, satisfaction, no-incident notes, or process completion into learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, scale, or closure claims
controls.closure_effect: suppresses or narrows public claims and keeps FT-0181 live until SRC2+ readout, claim-family effects, and reviewer calibration support closure review

controls.risk: end-of-window readout produces no owned post-readout action, repeats a broad packet request, or leaves public/lifecycle consequences ambiguous
controls.closure_effect: returns the packet to the owner and blocks rerun, continuation, lifecycle change, public-language change, and closure until the dispatch names owner action, next evidence ask, fields to re-ask/drop, and recheck date

controls.risk: PROCEED-STAGED intake bundle or workbench seed is treated as SRC2+ acceptance, custody evidence, closure evidence, or public-claim support before reviewer workbench acceptance
controls.closure_effect: keeps workbench seeds local, content-minimized, NOT_ACCEPTED, and explicitly outside SRC2+ acceptance, custody evidence, closure evidence, and public-claim support

controls.risk: phantom, release-controlled, malformed, premature, or wrong-class SOURCE_ARTIFACT drives local contact-clock progress
controls.closure_effect: blocks local contact-status recording when the source artifact is missing, controlled, malformed, premature, or wrong class; does not prove external send, owner receipt, evidence, or closure

release_boundaries: coverage controls can block false closure but cannot themselves supply SRC2+ pilot evidence
no control row may set may_close_ft0181=true while FT-0181 remains externally gated
release audits and assurance cases prove package consistency only, not learning or service effectiveness
The matrix does not close FT-0181; it only shows which blockers and reviewers must be consulted.
Release invariants, dependency graphs, delta manifests, recovery drills, and closure checklists cannot themselves supply SRC2+ evidence.
The closure evidence checklist does not close FT-0181 while required real evidence is missing.
A post-decision change ticket can organize owner decisions but cannot itself supply SRC2+ pilot evidence.
post-decision change tickets are overreach brakes, not real pilot evidence and not closure evidence by themselves
post-readout context receipt reroute gatees convert readout dispositions into owner actions; they are not learning or service effectiveness evidence and do not close FT-0181
The eight-row owner reply sheet does not close FT-0181 and is not learning or service effectiveness evidence.
Owner-reply intake controls cannot themselves supply SRC2+ evidence.
verified source-artifact traces are local routing controls, not evidence or delivery proof
